test_HfFileSystem_open: test the HfFileSystem open method to read and write files from Hugging Face repositories
test_HfFileSystem_resolve_path: test the HfFileSystem resolve_path method to parse repository paths with revisions and namespaces
test_HfFileSystem_glob: test the HfFileSystem glob method to search for files and directories in Hugging Face repositories
test_HfFileSystem_find: test the HfFileSystem find method to recursively list files with optional depth and detail constraints
test_HfFileSystem_cache: test the HfFileSystem instance cache behavior across multiprocessing spawn, fork, and thread pools
